nodes.title: Install python-decouple dependency
nodes.description: Install the python-decouple library via Poetry to enable secure loading of environment variables in Django.

nodes.title: Configure Django settings to load environment variables
nodes.description: Update Django settings files to load all configuration from environment variables using python-decouple instead of hardcoded values.

nodes.title: Add environment variable validation at startup
nodes.description: Implement a startup check that validates all required environment variables are present and correctly formatted before Django initialization.

nodes.title: Create JWT secret generation utility
nodes.description: Create a command-line utility script that generates cryptographically secure random secrets for JWT_SECRET_KEY and SECRET_KEY.

nodes.title: Configure Vite to load environment variables
nodes.description: Ensure Vite is properly configured to load environment variables from .env.frontend file with TypeScript type definitions.

nodes.title: Create environment variable access helper
nodes.description: Create a centralized utility module for safely accessing environment variables with validation, type conversion, and fallback values.

nodes.title: Test backend with valid environment configuration
nodes.description: Create integration tests that verify Django backend correctly loads and uses environment variables with valid .env.backend file.

nodes.title: Test backend error handling for missing variables
nodes.description: Create integration tests that verify Django backend fails gracefully with clear error messages when required environment variables are missing.

nodes.title: Test frontend environment variable loading
nodes.description: Create tests for frontend environment configuration helper to verify correct loading, parsing, and validation of environment variables.

nodes.title: Update setup documentation with environment configuration
nodes.description: Update local development setup documentation to include comprehensive instructions for environment configuration.

nodes.title: Create environment variable reference documentation
nodes.description: Create comprehensive reference documentation for all environment variables with descriptions, formats, and examples.

nodes.title: Verify .env files excluded from Git
nodes.description: Verify .env files are properly excluded from Git and add validation to prevent accidental commits of secrets.

edges.reason: python-decouple must be installed before configuring Django to use it
Django settings must be configured to load environment variables before validation can be added
Configuration loading and validation must be implemented before testing
Validation logic must be implemented before testing error scenarios
Vite configuration must be set up before creating environment helper
Environment helper must be implemented before testing it

phases.name: Backend Configuration Foundation
phases.description: Install dependencies, configure Django settings to load environment variables, add validation, and create secret generation utility

phases.name: Frontend Configuration
phases.description: Configure Vite and create environment variable access helper with type safety

phases.name: Testing
phases.description: Integration tests for valid and invalid configuration scenarios in backend and frontend

phases.name: Documentation
phases.description: Update setup documentation, create environment variable reference, verify Git exclusions (can run in parallel with other phases)
